text:
Alex (AE): Nimbus asks for a 14-day proof-of-concept on a dedicated guest pool. Requirements: baseline 4 A100-equivalent, autoscale to 12 for bursts, KV caching enabled, and a temporary burst discount to keep demo costs predictable. Need deal-desk + finance sign-off and infra to stand up the pool.

Maria (Sales Ops): @Sam (Deal Desk) pls review. Add billing tag `nimbus-poc` and request a prorated invoice. :memo:

Priya (Solutions Eng): We can spin a guest pool with mixed GPU flavors to lower cost (A100 + A500). Suggest autoscale config: min 4, max 12, burst cap 1200 req/min. Will enable KV prefix caching and response logging for eval hooks.

Eli (SRE): Ops note: without a committed SKU this is ephemeral dedicated and may produce overage. We can enforce a spend cap at $8,000/week and rate-limit bursts. Pool provisioning after signed amendment + billing info.

Jonah (Finance): Provisional finance stance: $8k/week cap acceptable for trial if sales covers overage post-demo. Approve one-time 50% off burst tokens for 14 days with Deal Desk approval and amendment. Need SKU mapping for mixed-GPU billing lines.

Sam (Deal Desk): Entering provisional approval: 50% burst discount for 14 days contingent on either prepay 50% of estimated spend or PO on file + Finance signoff (net30). Require amendment signed and one-off SKU NIM-TRIAL-001.

Alex (AE): Customer prefers PO + net30. I'll chase signature and PO today.

legal-bot: Drafting 14-day amendment (temporary discount, no SLA, refund cap 7 days). Will escalate for expedited signature.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Engineering requests logging enabled for quality telemetry and a model-variant rollback plan if regressions appear. We'll instrument eval hooks during the demo.

Eli (SRE): Will tag all usage with `nimbus-poc` and create pool once amendment + PO are received. Who provides final approval for the discount?

Sam (Deal Desk): Sam ok to approve once PO + signed amendment + Jonah confirmation. No provisioning until conditions met.

deploy-bot: Created temp-pool ticket #582; status: awaiting amendment & billing.

Alex (AE): Thanks everyone — chasing PO and signature now. Will update thread with attachments. :pray:

(End of thread)
